concentration_flags: UBER is ~79.27% of NAV -- a single adverse event (the pending $40M California wrongful-death ruling, broader rideshare-safety litigation wave, the pending Delivery Hero acquisition's integration/financing risk, execution/leverage risk from the EUR4.5B euro bond raise, or intensifying robotaxi competition from Tesla's Cybercab rollout, Waymo, or Uber's own WeRide/Avomo-partnered Madrid robotaxi pilot) would disproportionately hit the portfolio; cash is effectively nil at ~0.22% of NAV, so there is no cushion against a UBER-specific shock.

trim_considerations.note: Bringing this back to the ~25% single-name guideline would mean reducing exposure by roughly $443.78 -- a consideration, not an instruction, and one that doesn't account for any tax consequences of selling, which this pipeline has no visibility into.
